title: hook.request@2
description: deep-hook's request line: the agent's hook JSON, stamped with seq and id; a spooled call let through because the hub was late is marked late, and a SessionStart says which billing keys are set.

seq.description: Wall-clock ns since the Unix epoch when the hook started, as a canonical decimal string.

id.description: The event's ULID, minted with its seq.

matched.description: The guard entries in rules.json the call matched, by name.

payload.x-opaque: the agent's hook JSON, unchanged; its adapter reads it

late.description: Set on a spooled call deep-hook let through because the hub did not acknowledge it in time or did not reply by its hold.

billing.description: Whether each billing key is set in the environment the agent gave deep-hook, by name: true or false, never a value.
